## VEED Clean Audio: Speech Cleanup — Workflow Guide

## Input Asset

- [veed_clean_audio_noisy_input.wav](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/veed_clean_audio_noisy_input.wav)

## What This Workflow Does
VEED Clean Audio (speech) → Save Audio.

Strip the noise around a voice recording and keep the speech: the node removes background noise, music and sound effects, washes the pauses clean, then optionally lifts the level to a target loudness. It is built for speech in any language and returns 48 kHz mono audio.

Best for: interviews, voiceover takes, phone and field recordings, and any dialogue that has to be intelligible before it is cut, dubbed or localized.

## How to Use
1. Load the recording in Load Audio. One speaker per file; anything that is not speech is treated as noise.
2. Set strength on the node: how much noise is removed under the voice. The default 0.874 is the tuned value.
3. Pick loudness. normalize (default) evens the level out to the target_lufs you set; keep input level leaves the gain as recorded.
4. Run the workflow. The cleaned speech is saved by Save Audio as an mp3 at V0.

## Limits
- Audio up to 1799 seconds (just under 30 minutes) per run.
- Output is 48 kHz mono, so a stereo or multitrack source is folded down and the delivered file is mono.
- Speech only: music and effects are removed together with the noise, not preserved.
- strength runs 0.0 to 1.0, default 0.874. Lower keeps more room tone behind the voice; pauses between words are always fully cleaned, and values above the default change little.
- target_lufs runs -40 to -8 LUFS, default -19. Peaks are capped at -1.1 dBTP, so loud targets stop early: typical speech settles around -15 LUFS instead of reaching the number you typed.
- Keep input level skips the gain stage entirely, so only denoising happens.

## Tips
1. Give it the cleanest take you have: denoising cannot restore words that were never recorded, and heavy clipping stays clipped.
2. If the voice sounds hollow or gated, lower strength a step; if room noise still leaks through under the words, raise it. Only the speech-level noise follows this knob, so a noisy tail between sentences is handled regardless.
3. Normalize once, at the end of the chain. Running several loudness passes in a row just re-limits an already limited file.
4. Check the pauses, not only the words: they should fall to near silence while the voice keeps its breath.
5. The template writes mp3 at V0, which is what the preview player in the frontend can play back. Switch the format on Save Audio to wav or flac when the next step is editing or another model run.
